rules.statement: Where, in a partition action, the Court approved of the scheme of partition proposed and made order allotting the shares in severalty in accordance with the scheme, but no final decree was entered, such order allotting the shares constitutes the final judgment in the action.
rules.supporting_quote: Held , that the order allotting the shares constituted the final judgment in the, action and that a conveyance made after such judgment, but before the final decree was entered up, was valid.

meta.parties: Abdul Aziz v. Thamby Appu Et Al
